# GBot native rig — upstream reference only

Original repository: https://github.com/godotengine/godot-demo-projects/tree/master/2d/skeleton
The original `player/player.tscn`, `player/player.gd` and `player/gBot.png` are imported byte-for-byte and can be compared with the upstream blob SHA.

- GBot character: Copyright © circa 2020 Andreas Esau, MIT license (per upstream README).
- Rigging and animation: Copyright © 2020 RustyStriker, MIT license (per upstream README).
- Godot-demo-projects repository license is preserved in `LICENSE_GODOT.md`.
- `project.godot` is adapted from upstream solely to launch `preview.tscn`; these two files are *not* original upstream files.

Open this folder as a separate Godot 4.7 project, not as the Tavi/Rumo game. The robot is an **engineering reference**, not Tavi and not Rumo. Its anatomy is differently proportioned; never replace either game's approved character with GBot.
